task_goal: Test whether LIF membrane-state dynamics on the full biological graph converge to an input-independent fixed point and whether per-frame drive reinjection or an input residual path breaks the collapse.

guidance_provenance.threshold_policy: Do not lower any C1 threshold. The only numeric Expected Results threshold available in this workspace is lif+skip - stateless+skip >= 0.15 with CI lower > 0; absent guidance.md fields remain explicitly unavailable rather than invented.

synthetic.pixel_transform: sparse ink = 1 - uint8_pixel/255; black dot on white background
synthetic.per_frame_receptor_drive_normalization: divide by frame maximum when positive
synthetic.flash_control: same static centered dot with independently randomized temporal on/off pattern; direction labels retained only as a preregistered negative control

davis_v1_only.name: DAVIS-2017 full-frame v1
davis_v1_only.frame_selection: all complete consecutive non-overlapping 8-frame windows, sorted lexicographically within each sequence
davis_v1_only.pixel_processing: BGR decode -> grayscale using OpenCV COLOR_BGR2GRAY -> INTER_AREA resize to 32x32 -> float32/255; flatten all 8 frames in temporal order
davis_v1_only.label_rule: For every frame with nonempty foreground, compute full-resolution foreground x centroid. Fit OLS x_centroid = intercept + slope*frame_index across all 8 frames. right iff slope > +0.25 original pixels/frame; left iff slope < -0.25; discard otherwise or if any mask is empty.
davis_v1_only.balance_rule: deterministically downsample the majority class without replacement using seed 20261108 after all clips are labeled
davis_v1_only.split_rule: 70/30 sequence-group-disjoint GroupShuffleSplit for each seed; retry deterministic offsets up to 100 until both classes occur in train and test; no frame/clip leakage across a sequence
davis_v1_only.ceiling_model: fold-fitted StandardScaler + PCA(32 if required by >2000 raw dimensions) + RidgeClassifier(alpha=1e-2)

sintel_v1.name: MPI-Sintel GT-flow full-frame v1
sintel_v1.pixel_processing: clean pass full frame -> grayscale -> INTER_AREA 32x32 -> float32/255; flatten temporal order
sintel_v1.label_rule: median finite ground-truth horizontal optical flow over all pixels and all available adjacent frame pairs; right iff > +0.25 px/frame, left iff < -0.25, discard otherwise
sintel_v1.split_rule: 70/30 sequence-group-disjoint splits using the same deterministic policy as DAVIS
sintel_v1.availability_rule: archive not fully acquired and validated in one 120-second guarded request, or mean five-seed ceiling < 0.70 => unavailable

real_domain_preregistration.migration_claim_rule: If both real domains are unavailable, report SYNTHETIC mechanism results only and make no SYNTHETIC-to-REAL transfer claim.

graph.node_index: sorted union of root IDs appearing in full edge table
graph.adjacency_definition: A[post, pre] = log1p(sum syn_count for duplicate nonzero edges)
graph.storage: COO to CSR; sum_duplicates; eliminate_zeros; float32
graph.normalization: A *= lambda / spectral_radius(A); no row normalization
graph.K_auto_rule: Report shortest-path exact-hop eye-to-KC counts for 1..8. If requested K has zero KC, choose the first K in 5..8 with >0; if none, use fixed random 1024 nodes from exact hop 2 or 3 and mark fallback.
graph.eye_mapping: Normalize x_axis/y_axis ranges to the 32x32 pixel-grid range; build cKDTree on eye coordinates; assign every pixel to its nearest eye neuron (Voronoi); aggregate colliding pixels by maximum.
graph.degree_null: Keep reciprocal directed edges and self loops fixed. Pair the remaining nonreciprocal edges once under seed 20261109 and perform collision-free directed endpoint swaps (u->v,x->y to u->y,x->v), rejecting self edges, existing edges, duplicate proposals, and proposal/reverse-proposal pairs. This preserves each node's in/out degree, nnz, weight multiset, and reciprocal directed-pair count exactly; report rewire fraction and assert every invariant.
graph.identity: A=I at identical lambda-scaled identity dynamics, same K, tanh/LIF settings
graph.a_zero: No graph propagation; temporally ordered raw input-drive feature; explicitly an input-information upper bound, never evidence of biological-wiring superiority.

dynamics.stateless: For each frame independently, x_0=eye drive and x_h=tanh(A_lambda @ x_(h-1)) for h=1..K; readout uses temporal mean at selected KC/readout nodes.

lif_homeostasis.equation: v = 0.6*v + syn + drive; hard=(v>=0.15); v -= 0.15*hard; soft=sigmoid((v-0.15)*20)
lif_homeostasis.synapse: edge index-add from previous hop hard spikes, with edge weight * 8/fan_in * 8
lif_homeostasis.baseline_drive_policy: inject receptor drive at hop 0 of frame 0 only
lif_homeostasis.drive_every_frame_intervention: inject each frame's receptor drive at hop 0 of every frame
lif_homeostasis.spatial_steps_per_frame: resolved K; membrane state persists across hops and frames
lif_homeostasis.readout: mean KC soft spikes over 8 frames at resolved K

lif_combo.ei_sign: presynaptic sign from annotation neurotransmitter class when available; inhibitory for GABA/glutamate, excitatory otherwise; unresolved signs default excitatory and are counted

dynamics.frozen_gain_control: replace 8/fan_in*8 by its graph-wide mean finite value while holding all other settings fixed

feature_and_readout.pca_fit_scope: training fold only, independently for every seed and feature branch
feature_and_readout.skip_alignment: fit PCA(32) separately to propagated and raw temporally flattened input branches on train only, concatenate, then fit train-only PCA to final 32 dimensions so every ridge readout has equal feature count and parameter count; record dimensions and explained-variance retention
feature_and_readout.non_skip_alignment: train-only PCA to final 32 dimensions whenever raw dimension >32; all readouts receive <=32 features

variance_trajectory.hops: 0..resolved K for main conditions; 0..K for every phase-map cell

invariants.2_kc_feature_std: at least one biological-graph LIF intervention condition has KC feature std > 0; if not, finish all mechanism diagnostics before design_invalid
invariants.4_real_domain_ceiling: per-domain five-seed mean >= 0.70 or mark that domain unavailable

design_signal.information_erasure: If any hop has A=0 probe >= graph-condition probe + 0.15, label only as protocol diagnostic: graph propagation plus membrane state erases input information.
design_signal.fixed_point_prediction: Variance should monotonically approach zero in the high-lambda/high-K region and strongly interact with drive_every_frame. If the phase map has no such structure, mark the prediction falsified.
design_signal.expected_strong: lif_homeostasis+skip - stateless+skip >= +0.15 and bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
design_signal.minimum: Unavailable because guidance.md section Expected Results is absent from this clean workspace; intentionally not fabricated or lowered.
design_signal.failure_next_step: Narrow to an input-readout protocol-diagnostic negative result; retain all failure evidence; continue the same C1 because abandon_allowed=False.

statistics.paired_test: exact two-sided sign-flip over five paired seed deltas
